title: A Slack channel monitor files newsroom talk as Messages
description: Scenario: an editor connects #funny to the site; the monitor's next run copies new threads (with replies, authors as Slack display names) into newsroom Messages of kind newsroom_talk, and a later run adds only what is new. Scenario: a message deleted in Slack is withdrawn from the copy on the next run. Scenario: a channel the bot was not invited to is refused at connect time with a plain reason. Runs as a scheduled monitor through the standard automation records; uses the site's Slack connection, token in SSM.
